title: ageratina contorta
intro: Ageratina contorta, commonly known as Hierba de la Santa, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential to help alleviate various health conditions, including inflammation and digestive issues. The health benefits of Ageratina contorta include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
